name: app_background_return
description: An app opened once, then a later day. Launched two hours later with nobody looking, as a prewarm is (no open, no session); opened ten minutes after that; quiet in front for 20 minutes, then 15 in the background, which is 15 idle minutes and the same session; a second iPad window that comes and goes while the first stays in front (nothing); 40 minutes in the background, a new session; a push handled in the background inside the window joins the session and one outside it carries none; then killed while suspended and relaunched by a push, which opens nothing.
